Medical Laser Practice Book An Appointment 32k+ patients treated 150k+ Botox Injections 33+ Years in Practice The Cosmetic Enhancement Center is New England’s premier destination for aesthetic and cosmetic treatments, delivering personalized, expert services to patients from across Maine and New Hampshire. We’re proud to offer an extensive menu of aesthetic treatments that includes the latest in dermal fillers and injectables, leading laser services, skin rejuvenation treatments, Botox, CoolSculpting, and more. With convenient locations in Portland, Falmouth, and Waterville, ME, we offer welcoming, state-of-the-art medical facilities, innovative, effective treatments, a cosmetic boutique stocked with exclusive, medical-grade skincare products, and experienced, personable staff ready to help you meet your goals. We proudly offer complimentary consultations to determine which treatments are best for each patient’s individual needs. Book Online Current Specials Locations Botox & Injectables Laser & Skin Rejuvenation Body Contouring Aesthetic Services Botox & Injectables Our team of highly trained and experienced providers offer a full range of non-surgical injectable treatments to help you look and feel your best. From Botox and other neurotoxins, to the most popular dermal filler options, we will create a personalized plan to help you restore and maintain a youthful look. Contact Us Laser & Skin Rejuvenation Laser therapies offer a non-invasive solution for a range of skin concerns, including, but not limited to, unwanted hair, fine lines, pigmentation issues, and acne scars. We use precise and effective laser technology to help rejuvenate your skin, stimulate collagen production, and achieve a radiant, youthful complexion. Contact Us Body Contouring Even with the healthiest diet and most robust exercise routine, it can be difficult to achieve the toned look of your dreams. Non-surgical body contouring procedures can deliver a slimmer waist, firmer buttocks, and smoother thighs with no anesthesia, scarring, or downtime. In addition to Diamond Glow treatments, chemical peels, eyelash treatments, and other in-office treatments, we also carry exclusive medical-grade skin care products so you can better maintain your results and ensure healthy skin from home. Contact Us Maria Atkins, DO Co-Owner and Medical Director Maria Atkins, DO is the medical director and owner of the Cosmetic Enhancement Center of New England. Dr. Atkins is a leader in aesthetic treatments and brings the most advanced laser technologies and non-invasive techniques to CEC. Dr. Atkins has a thoughtful and compassionate approach when it comes to caring for her patients. She always has patients’ best interests in mind while working with them to achieve their overall goals and expectations. She is one of the most trusted physicians in Maine specializing in medical aesthetics.
